app.name: VARSHA
app.tagline: Regime-aware AI post-processing of NWP rainfall

encoding.layout: obs, then per lead: raw, cor, p_heavy, p_vheavy

regimes.name: Active Monsoon
regimes.desc: Monsoon trough south of normal, strong low-level jet; widespread heavy rain over central India and the west coast.

regimes.name: Break Monsoon
regimes.desc: Trough shifts to the Himalayan foothills; central India dry, rain over the foothills, NE India and the SE peninsula.

regimes.name: Monsoon Low / Depression
regimes.desc: Low pressure system from the Bay of Bengal moving WNW; very heavy rain in its south-west sector.

regimes.name: Coastal-Orographic
regimes.desc: Offshore trough / vortex; intense rain on the Konkan-Karnataka-Kerala coast and the Western Ghats windward slopes.

regimes.name: Western Disturbance
regimes.desc: Mid-latitude trough interacting with monsoon flow; heavy rain over J&K, Himachal, Uttarakhand and Punjab.

regimes.name: Normal / Transition
regimes.desc: Near-climatological monsoon flow without a dominant synoptic driver.
